frames.title: Anvil ready
frames.description: Front-right three-quarter. Standing behind a heavy iron anvil on a stout wooden stump, tongs in left hand hold a short billet on anvil, right hand grips hammer LOW beside hip, ready to work.

frames.title: Hammer raised
frames.description: Same camera, same anvil and stump and billet positions. Right hand raises hammer ABOVE shoulder, left tongs hold billet. Full raised hammer fits cell.

frames.title: Hammer contact
frames.description: Same camera and station. Hammer head rests ON billet at the bottom of the strike, elbow flexed, left hand holding tongs safely clear. No motion blur.

frames.title: Inspect tool
frames.description: Left-side view at same anvil, carefully examining the billet held in tongs at eye level, hammer resting on anvil.

frames.title: File tool edge
frames.description: Front-left view, filing the edge of a metal tool clamped in a small bench vise on a compact wooden workbench.

frames.title: Repair pickaxe handle
frames.description: Front-right view, seated at low repair bench tightening the metal head of a pickaxe onto its wooden handle, hammer and tongs laid on bench.

note: Character and work props are composed together. These six scenes are independent static references, not an animation loop.
